text_definitions.chunk_text_only: chunk_text as stored in document_chunks (ingest _read_body; title is a prefix of chunk_text for nearly all rows)
text_definitions.tokenizer_note: Official tiktoken (Docker image vector-drift-research-vector-drift-api). data/rev1_doc_token_cuts.jsonl was produced with official tiktoken and is not regenerated on the host. There is no pure-Python tokenizer fallback.
text_definitions.cut_char_8191: len(decode(tokens[:8191])) when that string is a prefix of text; else longest prefix with <=8191 tokens
text_definitions.openai_ingest_cap: document_chunks.chunk_text was already truncated to 8,191 tokens at ingestion (scripts/erb/ingest_erb.py lines ~108-110: truncate_for_embedding(_read_body(...)); apps/api/app/services/embedding.py MAX_INPUT_TOKENS=8191). Documents at the cap therefore have chunk_text tokens == 8191, not > 8191. title + ' ' + chunk_text can exceed 8191 tokens because the title is prepended again.
text_definitions.title_duplication: title + ' ' + chunk_text duplicates the title when chunk_text already starts with title (ingest _read_body).
text_definitions.db_token_count_column: present on document_chunks.token_count in this database; length stats here use tiktoken cuts, not that column
text_definitions.ladder_definition: embedding IS NOT NULL AND scale_rank IS NOT NULL AND scale_rank < 100000

all_rows.label: includes 3035 rows beyond the ladder (scale_rank >= 100000; all still have embeddings)

raw_pretruncation_chars.note: Character lengths of raw EnterpriseRAG-Bench files for documents at the ingest token cap (chunk_text tokens >= 8191) plus all primary-200 gold documents. No tiktoken. ingest _read_body is applied for raw_body_chars. chars_cut_* reported only for capped documents.

manager_quick_count_chars_only.note: Manager counted raw files over the whole manifest, not title + chunk_text and not the ingested ladder pool.
manager_quick_count_chars_only.why_16pct_raw_manifest_vs_20pct_db_pool: Different populations. The manager's 16% is the fraction of raw files with more than 8,191 characters across the whole manifest (n=184966 document records; Slack 40000 and Gmail 40000, which are mostly short). The database ladder pool (n=99998) caps Slack and Gmail at about 14,000-17,000 rows each (Slack/Gmail in this pool: see by_source_type.ladder_pool), so longer sources (Fireflies, Confluence, Drive) are over-represented and the share of documents with > 8,191 characters is about 20%.
